## Common warning signs

::: {.ftw-grid}

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-alarm" aria-hidden="true"></i> It's urgent
"Act now or your account will be closed."
Real companies give you time.
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-gift" aria-hidden="true"></i> Strange ways to pay
Gift cards, wire transfers, cryptocurrency, or a Bitcoin ATM.
Those are almost always a scam.
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-display" aria-hidden="true"></i> Pop-up "tech support"
A warning with a phone number to call about a virus.
Microsoft and Apple don't do that.
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-telephone-inbound" aria-hidden="true"></i> A loved one in trouble
A call from a grandkid who needs bail money, in a voice that sounds just like them.
AI can copy voices now.
Hang up and call them back on their real number.
:::

:::

## If you think you've been scammed

Don't be embarrassed.
It happens to smart, careful people every day.

1. **Stop** sending money or information, and don't answer the scammer.
2. **Call your bank** using the number on the back of your card.
3. **Call me.** I can check your computer or phone, change passwords, and help lock things down.
4. **Report it** at [ReportFraud.ftc.gov](https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/).

## Protecting yourself ahead of time

See my [favorite safety tools](tools.qmd) for the apps I recommend.

::: {.ftw-grid}

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-key" aria-hidden="true"></i> Better passwords
Set up a password manager and two-step login, so one leaked password doesn't open everything.
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-shield-check" aria-hidden="true"></i> Safer browsing
Ad blockers, antivirus, and settings that stop most scam pop-ups before you see them.
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-people" aria-hidden="true"></i> For families
Worried about a parent or grandparent?
I can set up their devices, agree on a family "safe word," and be their local call when something seems off.
:::

::: {.ftw-card}
### <i class="bi bi-megaphone" aria-hidden="true"></i> Group talks
I'm happy to give a friendly scam-awareness talk for your club, church, library, or senior group.
:::

:::
